name: session-stop-release-frees-the-first-held-path
description: Row 20's twin for the other end of the release loop: the same setup (session A takes EXCLUSIVE on plan.md, then CLAUDE.md, and stops), but session B pre-edits plan.md, the path A acquired first. B's acquire must be clean, the bare {ok:true}. Row 20 fails when the stop frees nothing or stops before the last grant; this row fails when the stop skips the first one, which row 18's answer and row 20 would both miss.
